title: Kissed Crisp Malaysian Sausage Noodles
description: A fermented, crisp, and cozy Malaysian dish featuring sausage and nimono-simmer, friendly to nut-free diets.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until lightly browned.
Add the Malaysian sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked rice noodles, soy sauce, and oyster sauce to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Stir in the sesame oil and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions.
Serve immediately, with additional soy sauce and sesame oil on the side if desired.
